root_text:
🚨 BIG BREAKING 🚨
India reports its FIRST case of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Bengaluru! 😱
An 8-month-old baby, with no travel history, has tested positive. This virus can cause severe respiratory issues. Stay alert, stay safe!

#HMPV #B
